h1: The Unboxing AI Product Video Generator
lead: Your shop's AI product video generator turns one photo of the cream mug's mailer into the teaser, the open, and the closer look. You skip the studio, and the product video is still ready for launch week.
summary: One package photo of the cream mug feeds the teaser, the open, and the closer look. Add the date and the price yourself, and hold the reveal until the page is live.

sections.h2: What to Show Before the Mug Comes Out
paras: A hand on the closed mailer shows the size, the lid lift is the open, and one sentence gives the clip a voice.
sections.alt: You get the teaser still. Hands hold the cream mug over the open kraft parcel and tissue.

sections.h2: How to Open the Mug and Give It a Voice
paras: Shoppers can judge the size from a hand on the closed mailer, on a kitchen counter. Hold the cream mug next to a book so the scale is obvious before the lid comes off.
Show the open itself: a hand on the lid, the tissue, and the cream mug coming out. Show the closed box first, open it when you start selling, and follow with one closer detail of that mug.
Say what is in the mailer in one sentence, such as one cream mug and the tissue. That sentence can name what a buyer will see when they open the box you actually ship.
sections.alt: You get the reveal. Hands open a blank kraft parcel and show the cream mug wrapped in tissue.

sections.h2: Filming the Unboxing vs Starting From a Photo
paras: Cost. A filmed unboxing pays a person, a place, and an edit. Here the clips draw from a monthly plan. Starter is $24.50 a month for 200 credits. Pro is $35 for 300. Premium is $63 for 600.
Timing. You start when the package photo of the cream mug exists. You do not wait on a booked crew or a studio afternoon.
How many clips. One photo feeds the teaser, the reveal, and the closer look. Each of those is its own clip, and you can run them side by side.
Who has to be there. The person who packs the mailers can make the three clips between orders. Nobody else has to come in.
Another version. A new sentence makes another clip when you want a different opening for the same mug.

paras: Paste the cream mug's page, or upload the mailer photo, through [URL to video](page:url-to-video). Upload Your Product Photo still starts the job, and the draft stays on the mug that is actually in the box.

sections.h2: What Photo Should a Launch Unboxing Start From?
paras: Use a clear photo of the cream mug in the packaging people will receive. Shoot it in daylight, with any plain face of the mug toward the camera.

If the box design is still changing, wait until you can photograph the package people will receive. The clip follows that photo and the box you describe. A stand-in box becomes the box shoppers expect. Count what ships. If the kit is only the mug and the tissue, those are what should come out. A listing address can fill the first draft. You still replace any photo that is not the package you will mail.
sections.alt: You get the mug beside its mailer. Hands place the cream mug beside the matching kraft parcel and folded tissue.

sections.h2: Which Unboxing Ideas Fit Launch Week?
paras: Plan a teaser, a reveal, and a closer look. Each one uses the same package photo and its own sentence. Use one saved avatar on all three.

The teaser shows the closed box and a hand on the lid. The reveal opens the tissue and lifts the cream mug out. The closer look turns the mug toward the camera. [Product videos](page:product-videos) fit when you want a demo after the open. [Image to video](page:image-to-video) fits when a photo of the closed box should simply start to move.
sections.alt: You get the start of the open. Hands lift the kraft lid and begin to show the cream mug.

sections.h2: How Do I Write the Scene for Each Launch Clip?
paras: Name the box, the hands, and the one motion. The date and the price go in the caption you type. A drafted script can suggest the line, and you shorten it to that one motion so the avatar still sounds like your shop.

The teaser can be a line such as hands resting on the lid of a plain kraft box, in soft daylight. The reveal can lift the lid and raise one cream mug out of the tissue. The closer look names the one detail you want turned toward the camera. Keep each sentence to one motion. Pick another voice if the tone does not fit the shop. Review the captions before you post.
sections.alt: You get the mug coming out. Hands raise the cream mug, with no lid, from tissue inside the kraft parcel.

sections.h2: What You Can Set on the Launch Clip
paras: The person who packs orders can make the first teaser without opening a timeline app. A photo of the mailer and the cream mug is the start.
You can set the tissue color and put your own mark in the corner before you download the cream mug clip.
You can pick a quieter voice when the shop's tone is calm, before the reveal of the mug goes up.
A monthly plan covers the set, so the teaser and the reveal do not each need a new quote from a crew.
The reveal can use the face from the teaser, so Thursday does not introduce someone new next to the mug.
Edit the draft so the spoken line matches the one motion in the clip. You decide the final words. The same line can be spoken in another language for a second market.

sections.h2: How Long Should a Launch Unboxing Be?
paras: Use 6 seconds for the teaser, and 10 seconds to open and show the cream mug. Use 15 seconds for a slower reveal, and 30 seconds when the box has more than the mug.

In that same order, they cost 24, 40, 60, and 120 credits. The cost shows before each clip starts. Each length is its own clip. Make the length you need for [TikTok](page:plat-tiktok). Make a longer one if the product page should show more of the unboxing.

faq.q: How do I make an unboxing video to sell a new product?
faq.a: Photograph the package people will receive, or paste the listing and replace any photo that is not that package. Pick an avatar, shorten the script to one motion of the mug leaving the tissue, and check the open before you post.

faq.q: How can I create an unboxing clip with AI?
faq.a: Start from the mailer photo, then approve one sentence about the cream mug coming out of the tissue. The clip should show that mug and nothing else in the box.

faq.q: How long should an unboxing clip be?
faq.a: Choose 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds. Six is a teaser. Ten opens and shows the cream mug. Fifteen is a slower reveal. Thirty covers a box with more than the mug. Make more than one length and keep the one that fits the placement.

faq.q: Can the open lead into a demo?
faq.a: Yes. After the cream mug is out of the tissue, the next beat can show it in use. You do not book a camera for that second beat.

faq.q: Can I start the cream mug unboxing from the product page?
faq.a: Yes. Paste the page if you do not want to retype the product name. The box in the finished clip still has to be the one you will mail, with the same cream mug.

faq.q: Can I change the voice, the music, and the captions on the mug clip before I post?
faq.a: Yes. Change the voice, the music, and the captions in the editor before you post. Type the date, the price, and any code yourself.

faq.q: How is this different from filming the unboxing?
faq.a: You start from the mailer photo of the cream mug instead of a booked afternoon. The next product is another mailer photo.

faq.q: How do I keep the mug unboxing in my shop's voice?
faq.a: Use the words you would say at the packing table. The voice should sound like the person who writes your captions for the mug.

faq.q: What if the video shows something that is not in my box?
faq.a: Make it again and name the exact contents, such as one cream mug in tissue. Shoppers will compare their package with the open they saw.

faq.q: What photo should I use to start the cream mug unboxing?
faq.a: Use a clear photo of the cream mug in the package, and list every item in the box. Check the opening, the reveal, and the final contents against the real package.

faq.q: How many credits does a cream mug unboxing clip use?
faq.a: A 6-second clip uses 24 credits. A 10-second clip uses 40, a 15-second clip uses 60, and a 30-second clip uses 120. If the clip fails, the credits come back.

faq.q: What if the cream mug's box is still changing before launch?
faq.a: Wait until you can photograph the final package. Describe the box people will receive, not a stand-in.

faq.q: Can one package photo make several launch clips?
faq.a: Yes. Reuse the photo, keep one saved avatar, and write a separate sentence for the teaser, the reveal, and the closer look.

faq.q: Can I send the clip to TikTok or Meta?
faq.a: Yes. After you check the unboxing, send it to TikTok, or to Meta, which covers Facebook and Instagram. Or download it with no watermark and upload it yourself.
